model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between age and the percentage of people with and without migration background. The x-axis is labeled “Alter” (age) and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 75, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Anteil Erwerbstätige in %” (percentage of employed people) and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. There are four lines shown: a black solid line labeled “ohne Migrationshintergrund” (without migration background) which begins at approximately 72% at age 20 and decreases to approximately 68% at age 75; a light gray solid line labeled “in Deutschland geboren” (born in Germany) which begins at approximately 65% at age 20 and decreases to approximately 63% at age 75; a light blue solid line labeled “zugewandert bis 2009” (immigrated until 2009) which begins at approximately 55% at age 20, fluctuates between approximately 55% and 65% until age 60, and then decreases to approximately 25% at age 75; and a dark blue solid line labeled “zugewandert seit 2010” (immigrated since 2010) which begins at approximately 40% at age 20, fluctuates between approximately 40% and 60% until age 60, and then decreases to approximately 10% at age 75.
